summary.text: Iris Sánchez is a Democratic member of the Connecticut House of Representatives serving New Britain, and sits on the Commerce, Veterans' and Military Affairs, and Finance, Revenue and Bonding committees.

paragraphs.text: La Voz Hispana reported that Sánchez, a New Britain Common Council member with eight years of service, received the Democratic Party's endorsement for the January 6, 2026 special election for the 25th District.

sources.title: Iris Sánchez Recibe Respaldo Demócrata para la Elección Especial del Distrito 25 en New Britain – LaVoz Hispana
